# Diseases

This folder groups diseases and medical complications associated with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) management in the Danish healthcare system. It covers severe gastrointestinal conditions, such as colorectal cancer and its mandated surveillance protocols, alongside significant IBD comorbidities like primary sclerosing cholangitis that require specialized, systematic monitoring to mitigate elevated cancer risks.

## Pages

- [[entities/diseases/gastrointestinal/index|Gastrointestinal]] — Catalogs severe gastrointestinal complications in IBD patients, focusing on colorectal cancer mortality risks and the national surveillance colonoscopy program.
- [[entities/diseases/ibd-comorbidities/index|Ibd Comorbidities]] — Documents conditions occurring alongside IBD that demand specialized monitoring, notably primary sclerosing cholangitis and its mandatory screening protocols to prevent cancer.
